lines.cap: Bernie Madoff. Former chairman of the Nasdaq stock market. A Wall Street legend.
lines.say: Bernie Madoff. Former chairman of the Nasdaq stock market. A Wall Street legend.

lines.cap: His fund paid about one percent a month. Every month. For decades. Even in crashes.
lines.say: His fund paid about one percent a month. Every month. For decades. Even in crashes.

lines.cap: Getting in was hard. So everyone wanted in. Celebrities, banks, charities.
lines.say: Getting in was hard. So everyone wanted in. Celebrities, banks, charities.

lines.cap: The secret? He never invested the money. He just paid old clients with new clients' money. A Ponzi scheme.
lines.say: The secret? He never invested the money. He just paid old clients with new clients' money. A Ponzi scheme.

lines.cap: An analyst named Harry Markopolos warned regulators for nine years. They didn't listen.
lines.say: An analyst named Harry Markopolos warned regulators for nine years. They didn't listen.

lines.cap: In 2008, clients wanted their money back. It wasn't there. He confessed to his own sons. They turned him in.
lines.say: In 2008, clients wanted their money back. It wasn't there. He confessed to his own sons. They turned him in.

lines.cap: He got a hundred and fifty years in prison. He died there in 2021.
